# `.github/workflows/`

| Workflow                  | Runs on                                                                                             | Does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ci.yml`                  | pull requests to `main` (including ready for review), pushes to `main`                              | **Quality Gate**: install, Linear key check, format check, lint, typecheck, test, build, `stackra gen` for each service under `services/`, the Squawk lint of the compiled `.stackra/migrations` (ADR 0159 d3), `pnpm validate`, `pnpm boundaries`, `pnpm knip`, `pnpm secrets:scan`. `deploy-staging` is a placeholder that deploys nothing until a deploy target is decided                                                                                                                                          |
| `release.yml`             | pushes to `main`                                                                                    | Calls `runway-npm.yml`: Trivy lockfile scan, then changesets: opens or updates the "version packages" PR as `stackra-bot`, publishes released packages to the Stackra registry (`registry`, ADR 0453) with provenance, one OIDC-exchanged token per package (no stored token), annotated `<name>@<version>` tags, and attaches a signed CycloneDX SBOM and a `sha256sums.txt` of the tarballs to each release. Waits for the owner's approval of the `release` environment                                                                  |
| `deploy-static.yml`       | pushes to `main` touching `workers/static/**` or `tools/schemas/**`, `schemas@*` tags, manual       | Calls `runway-cloudflare-workers.yml`: tests and builds `workers/static`, then `wrangler deploy` of the `stackra-static` Worker (static.stackra.figentra.com) with `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` decrypted from the sops scope `ci/deploy` (ADR 0525) ([ADR 0284](../../apps/docs/src/docs/adr/0284-hosted-static-files-one-cloudflare-static-assets-worker.mdx))                                                                                                                                |
| `deploy-docs.yml`         | pushes to `main` touching `apps/docs/**`, manual                                                    | Calls `runway-cloudflare-workers.yml`: `stackra build` of `apps/docs` (gen assembles the Fumadocs site in `.stackra/site`, React Router prerenders it), then the `stackra-docs` Worker (docs.stackra.figentra.com, assets only, `llms.txt` at the root) with `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` from ci/deploy, behind the production approval ([ADR 0514](../../apps/docs/src/docs/adr/0514-self-hosted-docs-replace-mintlify.mdx))                                                                                    |
| `apply-observability.yml` | pushes to `main` touching `packages/infrastructure/infra-observability/**` or `runway.yaml`, manual | Tests and builds `@stackra/infra-observability`, then `pulumi up` (manual: `preview` unless `apply` is ticked) of its `pulumi/` project in the `observability` environment (required reviewer): Better Stack uptime monitors of the registry, static and turbo-cache Workers, the OTLP source and the status page. Secrets decrypted from the sops scope `ci/deploy/observability`; applies nothing until the repository variable `OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED` is `true` ([Monitoring runbook](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/monitoring.mdx), STA-1573) |
| `runway-*.yml`            | `workflow_call` only                                                                                | Runway's public provider workflows (`cloudflare-workers`, `npm`) and the smoke step after a preview deploy (`smoke`: Playwright on the web surfaces, Maestro on the iOS simulator and the Android emulator, STA-265), released as `runway-v<n>` tags ([Runway runbook](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/runway.mdx))                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `linear-sync.yml`         | nightly, pushes to `main`, manual (with dry run)                                                    | `tools/scripts/linear-reconcile.mjs`: moves Linear issues to match merged and open PRs, closes decided ADR issues and labels stale work. Never fails the run                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `testbed-fallback.yml`    | manual only (`stackra testbed run --preset <name> --ref <ref>` when no testbed box is healthy)      | Runs one preset (`verify`, `e2e` or `integration`) for a pushed ref on a GitHub-hosted runner, with the licence and turbo tokens decrypted from the sops scopes `ci/build` and `ci/build/turbo`. Inputs are a preset name, never a command; advisory, never a required check ([ADR 0484](../../apps/docs/src/docs/adr/0484-the-testbed-disposable-image-built-test-boxes-a-container-per-job-and-secrets-from-infisical.mdx) decision 11)                                                                                                                                         |
| `testbed-image.yml` | pull requests touching the testbed images, the toolchain pins, or the lockfile and the files `pnpm fetch` reads | Builds the testbed job image, runs the `testbed-images` component's validate commands against it, and warms a pnpm store with no environment, then fetches offline from it, so an image change fails on its pull request and not in the owner's image build. No token; advisory, never a required check (STA-1953) |
| `apply-testbed.yml`       | manual only, `main`, `testbed` environment (owner approves each run)                                | Tests and builds `@stackra/infra-testbed`, signs in to AWS by GitHub OIDC (`TESTBED_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN`), creates the private state bucket on its first run, then `pulumi preview`, `pulumi up` or one image build of the `testbed` stack ([test infrastructure runbook](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/test-infrastructure.mdx), ADR 0484)                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## Rules

- Least privilege ([ADR 0019](../../apps/docs/src/docs/adr/0019-supply-chain-hardening.mdx) D2): `permissions` at the
  workflow is read-only or empty, and a job asks only for what it needs.
- No token is a repository secret: a job decrypts the sops scope it needs with the shared `secrets-decrypt` action,
  signing in to Google Cloud as itself over GitHub OIDC
  ([ADR 0525](../../apps/docs/src/docs/adr/0525-secrets-sops-and-cloud-kms-replace-infisical.mdx)). figentra/infra's
  `estate/secret-callers.mjs` grants each workflow, in its environment, its scopes: build and PR jobs read `ci/build`
  scopes on any ref; deploy and release jobs read `ci/deploy`, `ci/production` or `ci/production/release` in a
  protected environment, on main only.
- `stackra validate --repository` (rule `workflow-triggers`, STA-256) refuses a paid job (a macOS, Windows or larger
  runner, directly or from `strategy.matrix`; `eas build`; a device farm run; also inside a called local workflow) on a
  branch push, pull request or merge queue trigger, and, in a job with no `environment:`, a deploy credential in its
  env or a `vars.*DEPLOY*` or deploy secret read in a step's env, `with:` or `run:`. Exceptions, with a reason, go
  in `WORKFLOW_TRIGGER_ALLOWED` in `@stackra/repo-checks`; it is empty.
- Third-party actions are pinned to a commit SHA, with the version in a comment.
- The toolchain comes from `mise.toml`, so CI runs the same versions as a contributor.
- Turborepo remote cache (STA-1393): every job that runs turbo first decrypts the sops scope `ci/build/turbo`, which
  exports `TURBO_API`, `TURBO_TOKEN`, `TURBO_TEAM` and `TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY`. A fork pull request has no
  OIDC token, so ci.yml skips the step there and turbo uses its local cache only.

Runbooks: [CI](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/ci.mdx), [release](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/release.mdx).
